title: A Birthday to Remember
content:
Late that night...

Back in India, Sneha was fast asleep.

A gentle smile rested on her face as she slept peacefully, unaware of what was about to happen.

Slowly...

The door to her room opened.

A group of people quietly tiptoed inside.

Before she could fully wake up, someone gently covered her eyes with a soft blindfold.

"Hey... who's there?" Sneha asked nervously.

"Relax... just trust us," a familiar voice whispered.

Still confused, she allowed herself to be led outside.

A few moments later...

They stopped.

The blindfold was removed.

The lights suddenly came on.

"Happy Birthday, Sneha!"

The room echoed with cheerful voices.

Colorful balloons decorated every corner, and a large birthday cake sat in the center of the room.

Standing before her were Yagnesh and all of her childhood friends, smiling brightly.

For a moment, Sneha simply stared at them.

Then she glared.

"You idiots!"

"Is this how you surprise someone?"

"I almost had a heart attack!"

Everyone burst into laughter.

Yagnesh folded his hands dramatically.

"We just wanted this birthday to be unforgettable."

Sneha laughed, picked up a cushion, and threw it at him.

"You deserve that!"

The room filled with laughter once again.

One of her friends handed her a knife.

"Now stop scolding us and cut the cake."

Sneha smiled warmly.

She closed her eyes, made a silent wish, and cut the cake.

The celebration continued with laughter, old memories, photographs, and endless conversations.

For a little while...

Sneha forgot every burden she had been carrying inside her heart.

She was simply herself...

Surrounded by the people who loved her.

________________________________________

Later that night...

After thanking everyone, Sneha returned to her hotel.

She changed into comfortable clothes and lay down on the bed.

The silence of the room slowly brought back the thoughts she had forgotten for a while.

Will Siddu remember my birthday?

Does he still love me?

Will we ever meet again?

Or...

Has he forgotten me completely?

A faint smile appeared on her face.

"No..."

"He wouldn't forget."

Holding onto that small hope...

She slowly drifted off to sleep.

________________________________________

The next morning...

Sunlight streamed through the curtains.

Just as Sneha woke up, her phone began to ring.

Mom Calling...

She answered with a smile.

"Good morning, Mom."

"Good morning, birthday girl," her mother replied cheerfully.

They spoke for a few minutes about ordinary things.

Surprisingly...

Her mother never mentioned her birthday again.

Sneha smiled to herself.

Maybe Mom forgot...

Just then...

The doorbell rang.

"One second, Mom."

She walked to the door and opened it.

The moment she looked outside...

She froze.

Standing there with a bright smile was her mother.

"Happy Birthday, Dairy Milk!"

"Mom!"

Sneha immediately hugged her.

Her mother laughed and gently patted her back.

"I wanted to surprise my little Dairy Milk."

Sneha smiled happily.

"I really thought you forgot."

"A mother never forgets her daughter's birthday," her mother replied.

After they went inside, her mother looked at her and asked,

"So..."

"Are you going to the office today?"

Sneha shook her head.

"No, Mom."

"I've already taken leave."

Her mother smiled proudly.

"That's my girl."

For the first time in many months...

Sneha's heart felt completely at peace.
